entities.summary: Clearchus of Sparta (b. 401 BCE, Sparta) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Classical era, active in Sparta. He also participated in the Battle of Mantinea in 418 BCE. Clearchus' military campaigns had a significant impact on the development of Spartan military tactics and strategies.
